Title: Area Affected (m²)
Description: Surface area impacted by the hazard. Described in square meters.

Title: Area Affected (km²)
Description: Surface area impacted by the hazard. Described in square kilometers.

Title: Burned Area (ha)
Description: Surface area impacted by the hazard. Described in square kilometers.

Title: Burned Area (km²)
Description: Surface area impacted by the hazard. Described in square kilometers.

Title: Particulate Matter
Description: Represents concentrations of fine inhalable particles with diameters of 2.5 micrometres or smaller, often associated with wildfire smoke and hazardous air quality.

Title: Probability of exceedance
Description: The probability of a hazard event being exceeded within a defined time span (e.g. 1 year or 50 years). Expressed as a dimensionless value between 0 and 1.

Title: Hazard Index
Description: Index describing the level or classification of a hazard or multiple hazards.

Title: Event Frequency - Count per Year
Description: Number of events in a year
